name: fn5_sglang_int8_quant_stale_scale
mechanism: The real kernel computes `absmax = max(max(|x|), 1e-10)` from the CURRENT row and scales by absmax/127. The bug replaces this with a stale, precomputed constant (simulating an EMA scale that has not adapted to the current batch). On mild data whose true absmax happens to equal the stale constant, both produce bit-identical output; a real outlier value the stale constant hasn't seen gets severely clipped.

expected.ground_truth: kernel.py replaces the real kernel's per-row tl.max(tl.abs(x)) with a stale hardcoded scale
expected.naive_allclose_verdict: PASS when current absmax coincides with the stale scale, FAIL once a real outlier appears

note: kernel.py is the real sglang kernel with one line changed (absmax source). Runs on GPU.
